# BRANZ

> > Independent building research, testing, and quality assurance organization dedicated to affordable, resilient, sustainable, and quality buildings for Aotearoa New Zealand.

BRANZ (Building Research Association of New Zealand) provides evidence-based building research, testing services, standards development, and quality assurance programs including BRANZ Appraisals and CodeMark certification. The organization is funded through the Building Research Levy and works to advance construction quality, fire safety, sustainability, and housing affordability across New Zealand.

## Key Topics

- Building Research Levy
- BRANZ Appraisals
- CodeMark certification
- New Zealand Building Code
- AS/NZS 3500 (plumbing and drainage standards)
- Housing affordability
- Building resilience
- Sustainable buildings
- Fire safety
- Construction quality
- Testing services
- Construction standards
- Quality assurance
- ArchEngBuild 2026
